question: Which institute has developed hybrid aerogel to extract gold from e-waste in December 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**IISER, Pune**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 
• The **Indian Institute of Science Education and Research (IISER), Pune**, has developed a **hybrid aerogel** for extracting **gold from e-waste**. 
• This innovation provides an **eco-friendly and cost-effective solution** to recover precious metals from electronic waste, which is a growing concern globally. 
• The developed aerogel uses a combination of **biomaterials and synthetic materials**, making it highly efficient in adsorbing gold ions from e-waste solutions. 
• The aerogel exhibits **selective adsorption**, ensuring that gold can be separated from other metals present in e-waste. 
• This breakthrough technology is a significant step toward addressing the **environmental hazards** caused by improper e-waste disposal and supports the principles of **sustainable development**. </u
